name: Hellish Melody
author: RoWey
description: Time a click at 34% to fall up between the spikes and portal to just barely hit the teleport portal and to skip the cube portal, then hold at the floor until 35% where you can fall to the ceiling. Move to the floor at 72% and then time a release at 81% to go between both sets of saws. Stay at the ceiling until the end from there.
